name: ARPaS
description: A benchmark that evaluates adversarial robustness of panoptic segmentation models using adversarial perturbations and robustness-specific metrics.
evaluation_method: robustness metrics (drop in panoptic quality / mIoU under adversarial perturbations)
general_score_metric: panoptic quality (PQ) and adversarial robustness score (PQ drop)
reputation: Specialized benchmark with relevance for researchers studying adversarial robustness in panoptic segmentation; not yet broadly adopted outside that niche.
notes: Non-LLM, vision-only benchmark; performance depends strongly on the attack suite used and can be sensitive to evaluation protocols—risk of overfitting defenses to a fixed set of attacks.
